text_block_list.text:
In the first three years following her 
debut, Narita Top Road achieved remarkable 
results—

It seemed as though she had broken out of 
her shell. However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This time for sure...! N-Nggghhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Fell short again... Opera 
O-chan really is something else...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Did you truly think I would 
leave the throne abandoned forever?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"See you, Top Road-san. Let's battle it 
out again and again."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you 
again...!

She was caught from behind again, 
suffering many close defeats. You couldn't 
call her the undisputed strongest 
Umamusume. And yet...
(Chatter, chatter, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Th-This handshake line is... Is it just 
me, or is the line for me unusually 
long...?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah, Top Road-ooo! Look over 
here~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, yes... Is it over this way?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming out in such 
numbers, everyone...!

Her popularity always exceeded her race 
results. An honor student loved by 
everyone.

At first glance, she seems like a flawless 
Umamusume. Yet, watching her up close, 
that's not quite the case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "T-T-T-Trainer-san! C-C-C-C...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A crow! It's a crow! A crow just flew 
right at my feet!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I haven't been attacked. Still, it's a 
bit scary, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's big, and its beak is thick too. I was 
worried about what to do if it pecked 
me...

She was fine with other birds, but crows 
were a no-go. And then...
(Rustle rustle)

When we went on a hike: suddenly, she 
stopped on the mountain trail and stared 
intently at a single spot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you see it? Look, right over 
there...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's a fox. A parent and child fox. 
There's something really nice about that, 
isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, who knows? I haven't really 
thought much about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But you see, it's not like she's 
particularly clingy or snuggling up to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They're just standing side by side, 
perfectly still. It's nice, isn't it, 
seeing things like that...

To be honest, I don't know what's so great 
about it. But it seemed to strike a chord 
with her. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I made a new pouch for you to 
use during training."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I call it— the Exclusive Carrot Stick 
Pouch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Whenever I get hungry, I can just 
take it out and eat it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please, have some too, Trainer-san. With 
this, there's no need to worry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?
choice_data_list:
You're a pretty interesting Uma Musume, 
huh

You're a pretty interesting Uma Musume, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, a funny Umamusume... me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...? You're the 
only one who says things like that to me, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
People are always telling me that I'm far 
too serious, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it seems you might truly be the only 
one who understands the real me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you today 
as well. Munch on carrot sticks while 
giving it your—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's live up to everyone's 
expectations!

Always serious, kinder than anyone else, 
and deep down—

An Umamusume with a slightly funny charm. 
Beloved by all, Narita Top Road will 
continue to run.
